transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, thank you. Um, well, I'm here because I'm having a lot of trouble following through on tasks at work. I'm an auditor, and what really pushed me to make this appointment is that I keep starting follow-up items after my audits, or even after mentorship events, and I always have every intention of finishing them right then and there. 

But then... I'll find out days later that the final email, or a review note, or some form I needed to submit just never actually got done. It's happening a lot, and it's becoming a real problem for me.
Have you noticed similar difficulties with starting or finishing tasks in other areas of your life, like at home or in your personal responsibilities?

Yeah, I definitely do. At home, my husband has actually had to take over paying the bills and managing commitments that I originally agreed to do... he just can't count on me to complete them reliably anymore. 

And honestly, the work stuff I mentioned, it's getting pretty serious. My mistakes and those unfinished follow-ups reached the point recently where a client review was actually affected. I'm really starting to worry that people are questioning whether I can even handle the promotion I'm up for.
Can you tell me if you've been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, either at work or in your personal life?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I definitely get frustrated with myself when I drop the ball, obviously, but I don't feel hopeless or down in general. And I still enjoy doing the things I've always liked outside of work. It's really just the stress of falling behind and making these mistakes that's getting to me, not a lack of interest.
Have you been feeling more forgetful, distracted, or disorganized lately, even when you're trying to focus on something important?

Yes, very much so, especially with being distracted. It's like I can't filter things out. If I'm trying to review an audit file—which is obviously important—the slightest thing will derail me. A Slack ping pops up, or I hear someone talking outside my office, and my focus is just gone. It doesn't even have to be external; sometimes just a random thought about my marathon training will pop into my head, and suddenly I'm completely off track and have forgotten what I was just looking at.
Have you noticed yourself feeling restless, fidgety, or having a hard time staying still, especially in situations where you're expected to remain focused or seated for a while?

Yeah, I do. Um, especially in meetings. When I'm sitting there, I'm usually tapping my foot under the table or clicking my pen. I shift around in my chair a lot, too. Actually, one of my colleagues joked recently that she can hear my leg going during long meetings. I just have a really hard time staying still for that long.
